name: backend-atlas
description: Backend Atlas - AX and backend engineering learning platform

scripts.test: node scripts/smoke-test.mjs && node scripts/test-education-quality-contract.mjs && node scripts/test-learning-runtime.mjs && node scripts/test-learning-visuals.mjs && node scripts/test-atlas-access-monitor.mjs && node scripts/test-learn-deploy-contract.mjs && npm run test:interview && npm run test:backend-study
scripts.test:interview: node scripts/test-interview-schema.mjs && node scripts/test-interview-source-coverage.mjs && node scripts/test-interview-fact-consistency.mjs && node scripts/test-interview-duplicate.mjs && node scripts/test-interview-secret-scan.mjs && node scripts/test-interview-runtime.mjs
scripts.test:backend-study: npm run backend-study:data && node scripts/test-backend-study-schema.mjs && node scripts/test-backend-study-source-coverage.mjs && node scripts/test-backend-study-secret-scan.mjs && node scripts/test-backend-study-runtime.mjs && node scripts/test-backend-study-progress-migration.mjs && node scripts/test-backend-study-route.mjs
scripts.test:release: npm run test && npm run quality:audit && node scripts/test-content-quality-audit.mjs && npm run build:release && node scripts/test-build-provenance.mjs --release
scripts.quality:audit: node scripts/content-quality-audit.mjs && npm run interview:audit && npm run backend-study:audit
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
